reviews.review:
Posting this review so that people are more aware of what to expect from the game. 

Pros:
-Character customization is fun
-The desk companion feature is cute and adds a little bit of fun to my tasks (it's probably the reason why my recorded playtime is so high).
-Some of the fanfictions you unlock are very enjoyable to read and interesting
-I like the fake merchandise that you can collect of your characters. I also appreciate that you can freely switch which characters are in which role. 

Cons:
-The main reason why I can't recommend this game to other people is because it is a bit buggy. The worst bug of all is in its filtering system. Neither the warning system nor the content blocking system seem to work properly. I've gotten jump scared a few times by some unsavory content that I didn't expect to see in certain fics. This includes one character taking advantage of a drunk character, a character almost having a miscarriage after a car accident (which is never mentioned again in the fic), sudden confinement that was not originally tagged in the fic, a character's drink getting spiked and then suddenly being "touched" by a bunch of hands (this one truly came out of nowhere, which led to me exiting the fic immediately). 
I don't have a problem with dark content existing in media. My problem is that this game is supposed to have a filtering system that makes it optional, but it doesn't work. I still haven't decided on if I'd like to get a refund on the game or not. I don't like randomly being jump scared when I think my player character is writing a regular fic, but there are also a few unique aspects of this game that I still enjoy (such as the desk companion feature).
I wouldn't recommend playing the game in its current state if you are sensitive to any of the content mentioned in the above paragraph. 
-To be completely honest, the main story that follows the game's original characters isn't too interesting to me. I usually enjoy stories about creative people exploring their hobbies, but there's just something about the way this game's story is written that hasn't really captivated me. 

Overall, I have mixed feelings about this game. There are aspects of it that I like and I appreciate the unique concept, but some of the unsavory aspects make it difficult for me to enjoy the game as a whole.
